scope: Shared CTC loss and every derivative component, including OCR and ASR public training; no API, model format, dependency or impossible-target policy change.

acceptance.public_training: Controlled constant CTC logits, returned positive loss matches independent reference, target Readout coefficient initially zero receives a positive nonzero update through verified positive hidden activity; normal zero-logit controls also receive a real positive target coefficient update. learning.Parameters has no ReadoutBias field, so the fixture uses the existing public Readout coefficient. Loss and update checks execute independently.
